title: Add an automated official-NFL snapshot job
current_state: Root index.html, own5-desk/, line-lab/ and nfl-strategy-lab/ are all frozen at 2026-11-02 and are missing 16 completed games (Week 8 MNF + all 15 Week 9 games).
suggestion: Add a scheduled job that re-fetches nfl.com/standings, /schedules and /injuries on a fixed cadence and stamps each dataset with snapshot_on, so no board can silently go stale.
improves_decision_making: Every downstream line, signal and leaderboard row is only as good as its snapshot date; a visible staleness counter prevents decisions on 10-day-old data.
risk_if_ignored: Boards keep pricing games as unplayed after they are final (see RA-02).

title: Consolidate the four parallel NFL boards onto one shared official ledger
current_state: index.html, own5-desk/, line-lab/ and nfl-strategy-lab/ each maintain their own standings/game store with disagreeing values (RA-02, RA-05).
suggestion: Publish one canonical data/games_2026.json + data/standings_2026.json pair and have every subsite read from it instead of re-scraping.
improves_decision_making: Removes contradictory numbers on screen; a reviewer can trust one number instead of reconciling four.
risk_if_ignored: Parallel sessions keep overwriting each other (RA-12).

title: Stop presenting third-party sportsbook lines as if they were verified market data
current_state: lines_upcoming_2026.json and futures_superbowl_2026.json are ESPN/DraftKings scrapes with 3 malformed open-spread tokens and a 16-of-32 team futures truncation (RA-05).
suggestion: Either license an official market feed, or label every market column as 'third-party, unverified' and exclude it from edge/CLV math by default.
improves_decision_making: Edge and CLV computed against a malformed third-party line are worse than no edge at all.
risk_if_ignored: Edge figures silently inherit scraping errors.

title: Make the starter-to-backup string depth adjustment mandatory in every line
current_state: Prior Week 9 originators priced BAL as healthy despite Lamar Jackson on IR; JAX then won 33-10 (RA-06).
suggestion: Require every originated line to carry an explicit, itemised injury/depth delta column listing the active string (1st/2nd/3rd/4th) at each affected position.
improves_decision_making: A 3rd-string QB is not a 1-point effect; itemising it makes the largest single-team error source reviewable.
risk_if_ignored: Repeat of the 23-point BAL error class.

title: Replace backtests computed on third-party GitHub datasets with official-ledger walk-forward tests
current_state: nfl-strategy-lab backtest/correlation/luck CSVs depend on tobycrabtree/spreadspoke (assumed -110 vig) and brianfoshee/nfl-play-by-play-data (RA-04).
suggestion: Backtest only against the official 136-game ledger, walk-forward, with the assumed price declared and the binomial p-value published next to every win rate.
improves_decision_making: A win rate without a sample size and a p-value cannot separate a 60% skill edge from a 12-bet hot streak.

title: Publish Deflated Sharpe Ratio and Holm-Bonferroni adjusted p-values for the whole strategy family
current_state: Prior leaderboards rank on raw ROI with no multiple-comparison control.
suggestion: Rank only on DSR; show raw p, expected-max p under the null, and Holm-adjusted p side by side.
improves_decision_making: With 10 candidate strategies, one will look 'significant' at p<0.05 by chance alone; DSR/Holm is what survives.
risk_if_ignored: The leaderboard's #1 entry is the luckiest, not the best.

title: Split the root index by domain (NFL / NBA / SF-rent)
current_state: Root index.html is NFL-dated 2026-11-02 while root EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md is NBA-dated 2026-11-11 across 20+ mixed-domain subsites (RA-01).
suggestion: Make the root index a pure domain router; each domain owns its own dated landing page.
improves_decision_making: A reviewer landing on a mixed-domain page cannot tell which numbers belong to which analysis.

title: Make the source link a required, rendered column on every data table
current_state: Several boards carry a source_url column in CSV but do not render it in the HTML table.
suggestion: Emit a 'Source' anchor cell on every row so a reviewer can click through row by row without opening the CSV.
improves_decision_making: Verification is only real if the reviewer can reach the source in one click from the row they are checking.
risk_if_ignored: Line-by-line verification does not actually happen.

title: Only price parlays with measured correlations and explicit Frechet bounds
current_state: Prior parlay tables price legs as independent (RA-04).
suggestion: Compute paired Pearson r from the official 50-game player log, publish the joint probability, the lift over independence, and the Frechet-Hoeffding min/max.
improves_decision_making: Two positively correlated legs priced as independent overstates the parlay's true probability and its true payout.
risk_if_ignored: Parlay leaderboard is structurally biased toward correlated longshots.

title: Handle ties as first-class records
current_state: Prior ingestion dropped ties, reporting NYG as 4-2 and WSH as 2-4 instead of 5-2-1 and 2-5-1 (RA-05).
suggestion: Carry the T column everywhere and compute PCT as (W + 0.5T) / GP, matching the official NFL rule.
improves_decision_making: A dropped tie changes a team'srank and every rating derived from it.
risk_if_ignored: Standings tables will not reconcile to nfl.com (see FLG-02).

title: Retire the dead operations.nfl.com injury-policy citation
suggestion: Repoint to the live 2026 rulebook and player-health pages, and add a build-time link checker to the CI workflow.
improves_decision_making: A reviewer clicking a 404 cannot verify the policy the site claims to follow.

title: Enforce branch-scoped claims in CI
current_state: Three parallel sessions collided on nfl-decision-desk/** (RA-12); coordination currently relies on manual discipline.
suggestion: Add a CI check that fails a PR when it touches files outside the path scope claimed for its branch in COORDINATION.md.
improves_decision_making: Reviewers lose trust when a session's work silently disappears in a merge.
